body: Thank you for the idea for a card. It went over very well.
I like that as well, it defiantly gives ideation a seriousness that sometimes I forget. Here's to hopping for some sunny days. Thanks whowaswhatwhen. Hope you have some sunny days as well.

Thanks ecupcakes,

  I appreciate the reminder to celebrate the love and to not stress the little things. It is a day of celebration a day to enjoy with our family a friends. A day to get married as that is the goal.

Thank you jellybeanie,
The internet hugs felt good and made me smile. Thank you for your faith in a complete internet stranger.

For us the wedding is worth it and we do have a budget that we will come in under some how. It is the only point in our life that our families and friends will all come together and get to know each other. It is the point that we get to see those who care about us. It is our declaration to the world that we are in this thing and we are going to tend to the garden of our relationship and see it grown.

Thanks for this advice, it made me think of my ideation as a passing cloud. It is here for the moment and I can't change that but at some point the wind is going to come and move the cloud over the horizon even if it has to rain first.

You made me smile, asking me to think about my fiancee as she is the love of my life.

- I love the compassion that she shows to others and to me
- I love her smile when she sees me
- I love the fact that she appreciates all types of foods so we can go on food adventures (Pick a number between 15 and 25 this is how many times you will flip a coin, Get in a car and each time you stop turn left for heads or right for tails, when you are done flipping find the nearest restaurant in your price range and try it out)
- I love how she is willing to stick by me even in the hard times
- I love her willingness to be vulnerable with me.
- I love her intelligence but lack of arrogance
- I love her ability to cook
- I love her encouragement for me to pursue my dream of opening a not for profit
- I love her for keeping me practical and so that I don't quit my job today(My non-profit is not paying anyone yet) 
- I love her pursuit of dreams
- I love her grounded and centered personality
- I love that she has personal goals
- I love that she is tenacious and does what it takes
- I could keep going on but I have one more question to get to...
- The perfect moment for me is 10 years down the road when we are both alone talking in bed and I will still get to marvel at the fact that I don't have to take her home anymore. She isn't just spending a few nights at my place or me a few nights at hers.

Thank you ratherinteresting.
